description: This file defines the class EmailsDataAddressCollector, which is responsible for collecting and processing email address data from inbound email accounts for the SuiteCRM email module. It handles validation, data structuring, and integration with outbound email settings, signatures, and system emails.

classes.name: EmailsDataAddressCollector
classes.description: Main class responsible for collecting and processing email address data for SuiteCRM email functionality, including validation, signature handling, and system email integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collector with the current User object and SugarCRM configuration.

methods.name: collectDataAddressesFromIEAccounts
methods.description: Main method to collect data addresses from inbound email accounts, handling validation, options, and signatures.

methods.name: validateInboundEmail
methods.description: Validates that an inbound email object is of correct type.

methods.name: getOutboundEmailOrError
methods.description: Retrieves outbound email object based on stored options, handling errors if not found or invalid.

methods.name: setOe
methods.description: Sets the outbound email object.

methods.name: retrieveFromDataStruct
methods.description: Retrieves data from stored options, handling errors if previous validation failed.

methods.name: logReplyToError
methods.description: Logs and validates reply-to address format, checking for errors.

methods.name: getTmpNameForLogReplyToError
methods.description: Parses and logs reply-to name component errors.

methods.name: getTmpAddrForLogReplyToError
methods.description: Parses and logs reply-to address component errors.

methods.name: validateForLogReplyToError
methods.description: Validates reply-to components, raising errors for invalid formats.

methods.name: getReplyTo
methods.description: Returns the reply-to address string.

methods.name: getDataAddressFromIEAccounts
methods.description: Constructs a data address array from inbound email account details, signatures, and options.

methods.name: getDataAddressArrayFromIEAccounts
methods.description: Creates a data array representing the email address details for an inbound email account.

methods.name: getOeId
methods.description: Returns the outbound email ID.

methods.name: getOeName
methods.description: Returns the outbound email name.

methods.name: getEmailSignatureId
methods.description: Gets the email signature ID associated with the inbound email.

methods.name: fillDataAddress
methods.description: Fills in email address data structures with system and personal addresses.

methods.name: fillDataAddressFromUserAddresses
methods.description: Adds user addresses to the data list if permitted by configuration.

methods.name: collectDataAddressesFromUserAddresses
methods.description: Creates data entries for each user address, including signatures.

methods.name: getFromString
methods.description: Constructs the 'from' string for user addresses, optionally using reply-to address.

methods.name: addCurrentUserToEmailString
methods.description: Adds the current user's full name to an email string.

methods.name: getSignatureHtml
methods.description: Retrieves HTML signature HTML with warning logs if missing.

methods.name: getSignatureTxt
methods.description: Retrieves plain text signature with warning logs if missing.

methods.name: getCollectDataAddressArrayFromUserAddresses
methods.description: Creates a data array for a user email address, including signature info.

methods.name: fillDataAddressWithSystemMailerSettings
methods.description: Adds system default mailer address if user has access.

methods.name: addSystemEmailAddress
methods.description: Adds the system email address to the data addresses if allowed.

methods.name: fillDataAddressFromPersonal
methods.description: Adjusts data addresses to include personal address attributes.

methods.name: getOe
methods.description: Returns the current outbound email object.

methods.name: getFillDataAddressArray
methods.description: Creates a data structure for a system email address.

methods.name: getOutboundEmailOrErrorByStoredOptions
methods.description: Retrieves OutboundEmail by stored options ID, with error handling.

methods.name: getReplyToOnError
methods.description: Provides reply-to address from stored options with logging.

methods.name: getFromNameOnError
methods.description: Provides from name from stored options with logging.

methods.name: getFromAddrOnError
methods.description: Provides from address from stored options with logging.
